subject.title: feat: add external archive provider sync

question: Should Slacrawl adopt `slacrawl-provider-v1` and its provider config, source-rank, and checkpoint semantics as a supported long-term core contract?
rationale: The PR creates a public executable protocol and persistent behavior that external providers and existing databases may depend on; tests cannot decide the intended stability commitment.

options.title: Adopt after proof
options.body: Approve the contract after a real provider demonstrates fresh import, search visibility, checkpoint resume, and safe schema-v5 upgrade behavior.

options.title: Incubate as experimental
options.body: Keep the draft open and explicitly reserve incompatible protocol revisions until external-provider usage validates the contract.

options.title: Decline the core API
options.body: Keep archive adapters source-specific or external rather than publishing a generic provider contract in core.

recommendation.title: Adopt after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the contract after a real provider demonstrates fresh import, search visibility, checkpoint resume, and safe schema-v5 upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed protocol and the current source architecture it extends, providing the strongest product and code ownership signal.
